title: Revithia Pakora
description: A crispy Indian snack made with chickpea flour and revithia, perfect for a crunchy delight.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine 2 cups of chickpea flour, 1/2 cup of Greek yogurt, 1/4 cup of water, 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of garam masala powder, and 1/4 teaspoon of red chili powder.
Mix the batter well to avoid lumps.
Heat sufficient indulgent oil in a deep frying pan for frying the pakora.
Dust the revithia mixture with flour to prevent lumps.
Drop the mixture into the hot oil with a spoon.
Deep-fry until the pakora is golden brown and crispy.
Serve hot with your favorite chutney or sauce.
